phrases.english: It’s getting late; let’s go home.

phrases.latin: Sed quoniam advesperāscit, dabis nōbīs diem aliquem, ut contrā ista dīcāmus.
phrases.english: But since it’s getting late, you’ll give us some day to reply to all this.

phrases.latin: Sed quoniam et advesperāscit et mihi ad vīllam revertendum est, nunc quidem hāctenus
phrases.english: But since it’s getting late and I must go back to the villa, that’s enough for now

phrases.latin: tū, ut tempus est diēī, vidē sīs nē quō hinc abeās longius.
phrases.english: and you, seeing what time of day it is, mind you don’t go off too far.

sources: Lewis & Short: advesperasco · Lewis & Short: vesperasco
Passages as cited on the grouped card.
